apps.description: Private chat and coding agents over the on-box models, the shared wiki and the Onyx knowledge index.
apps.name: lightforce agent command

variables.description: 64 hex chars encrypting conversation titles, messages and agent transcripts at rest. Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))". Keep it: changing it makes existing conversations unreadable.
variables.label: Chat encryption key
variables.name: INDIECHAT_ENCRYPTION_KEY

variables.description: Enables web search for chat, agents and routines. Set here rather than in the app's own settings: a key entered there lives in one browser and never reaches agent turns. Leave empty to disable web search.
variables.label: Web search key (Serper)
variables.name: SERPER_KEY

variables.description: Read token for the search app's /api/sources, used only to show which connectors feed the index on the Brain page. Leave empty to hide those figures.
variables.label: Onyx search token
variables.name: ONYX_SEARCH_TOKEN

apps.description: Creditreform chat, Insights dashboard and read-only revenue MCP as one app.
apps.name: creditreform:agents

variables.description: 64 hex chars encrypting conversation titles and messages at rest. Generate with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
variables.label: Chat encryption key
variables.name: CREFO_CHAT_ENCRYPTION_KEY

variables.description: Shared secret between the Datenpflege MCP sidecar and the Insights dashboard, which is the only writer of the customer DB. Generate any long random string; it never leaves the box.
variables.label: Datenpflege write token
variables.name: DATAOPS_TOKEN

variables.description: Bearer token required on every revenue-MCP and Datenpflege-MCP request. Leave empty to disable MCP authentication.
variables.label: MCP token
variables.name: MCP_TOKEN
